prompts.guide: Create ONE original small game menu node icon. Reference image 1 is the original Arknights node board: primary reference for compact symbolic silhouettes, localized light, quiet dark support and negative space. Reference image 2 is the USER-APPROVED modern entrance icon from THIS menu: match its illustration family, chalky broad opaque planes, restrained grain, slightly asymmetrical contours, light-dark separation, subject scale and sparse fine drips/dots. Do not draw a doorway or copy its shape. One recognizable main silhouette readable at 48px; 3-5 large opaque color planes, subtle hand-drawn shape rhythm and internal negative spaces. Main subject 40-48% canvas; low-contrast near-black cool irregular circular support 52-60%, portions of edge disappear. One localized light event connected to subject's lit face and edge, with softly fading colored bloom, not a separate lamp or large fog cloud. Generous true RGBA transparent margins. No text, glyphs, lettering, border, checkerboard, rectangular background, glossy 3D, thick bevel, photoreal object, ornate detail, uniform all-around glowing ring or dense surface texture. One individual icon, not a gallery. SURVIVAL GUIDE. One compact open handbook with two unequal slightly curled page masses, visibly readable as an open book, off-center dark spine gap and a single coral bookmark wedge. Pearl gray-white pages, slate lavender shadow planes, small muted coral accent. A small warm peach light gathers in the spine and lights the adjacent page edges; faint violet haze behind upper-left. No writing, page lines, cover ornament or many individual sheets. Keep symbolic pages with wing-like contour rhythm, but still a book.
